record.summary: The observatory binary gains an `orchestrator` command group that is a pure client of the HTTP API: status, dag, next, start/pause/resume, spec controls (skip, retry-stage, reverify, force-gate, approve), decisions search, history, journal verify (offline, direct), and daemon start/stop/status with the identity-checked lock. Anything the UI can do, the CLI can do; several things (journal verify, daemon lifecycle) only the CLI does.
record.title: Orchestrator CLI: the primary control plane
